$schema_comment: Temporary npm advisory exceptions for CI. Each entry must name packageId, advisoryUrl, reason, and expiresOn (YYYY-MM-DD). Expired entries are ignored and the finding fails CI.

exceptions.reason: No patched braces release exists (all versions affected). Only reachable through http-proxy-middleware's micromatch pathFilter matching; frontend/server/app.ts configures no pathFilter, so braces never expands any pattern. Remove when a fixed braces/micromatch ships.
